description: Raw punch history (打刻履歴) for yourself: clock_in 出勤, clock_out 退勤, direct_in/out 直行/直帰, break_start/end 休憩入/休憩戻. Defaults: from=today, to=from, Japan time (YYYY-MM-DD). Max 366 days, fetched in chunks. Use get_today_status for today's state in one glance, and close_out for what to fix. Use this when you need the timestamps. Location and IP are omitted unless KINTAI_PLUS_INCLUDE_LOCATION=true.

from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD, Japan time). Defaults to today.

name: get_stamps
title: Get my punch history
